notificationTemplates.title: Notification templates
notificationTemplates.subtitle: Author, preview and publish the email/in-app/push templates the platform sends.
notificationTemplates.permissionBody: Notification template governance is available to university and partner admins only.
notificationTemplates.emptyBody: Create a draft template to get started.
notificationTemplates.formHint: Drafts can be edited freely. Publishing creates an immutable active version.
notificationTemplates.keyHelp: Stable identifier used by the dispatch service, e.g. job.approved.
notificationTemplates.subject: Subject (email)
notificationTemplates.subjectHelp: Only used for the email channel.
notificationTemplates.bodyHelp: Use '{{variable_name}}' placeholders — every placeholder must be declared below.
notificationTemplates.allowedVarsHelp: Every placeholder used in subject/title/body must be listed here.
notificationTemplates.requiredVarsHelp: Sending fails if any of these are missing at dispatch time.
notificationTemplates.previewHint: Fill sample values and render to proofread the layout — nothing is sent.
notificationTemplates.activateConfirmBody: This publishes the version and archives whichever version is currently active for the same key/channel/locale.
notificationTemplates.archiveConfirmBody: The version is retired. Activate another version to replace it later.
